The bundled standard-library checker reconstructs full three-dimensional projected convex hulls and confirms representative signs; its finite simulations are not the general proof.

value.rationale: Random viewing produces two basic geometric observables with the same normal. The theorem classifies their dependence for every convex planar base with just A, beta and a perpendicular-width moment, exposes an exact reciprocal-height duality and root-product invariant, and identifies opposite regimes for constant-width versus thin convex bases, with tangential equality bases. This is structural geometric-probability information beyond a box-only covariance or a routine moment value; it provides a meaningful complete natural classification.
